bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
stage="$root/.worktrees/gaybbs-common-full-review-afb725a"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = afb725a5f23844e1d2fcc53ffada231d8ee9faba || exit 71
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:reaudit-afb725a >/dev/null || exit 72
old="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$old" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 73
project="$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$old")"
test -n "$project" && test "$project" != "<no value>" || exit 74
actual="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
expected="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-711d7d6)"
test "$actual" = "$expected" || exit 75
docker tag "$actual" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-reaudit-20261120 || exit 76
(cd "$root/deploy" && docker compose -p "$project" -f gserver-compose.yaml config -q) || exit 77
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:reaudit-afb725a gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 78
if ! docker compose -p "$project" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-reaudit-20261120 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$project" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || true
 exit 79
fi
now="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$now" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 80
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$now")" = "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:reaudit-afb725a)" || exit 81
for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker logs "$now" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' && break; sleep 1; done
docker logs "$now" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 82
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test -n "$db" || exit 83
test "$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='gate_sessions' AND column_name='requested_talk_index';")" = 1 || exit 84
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 85
echo GAYBBS_REAUDIT_LIVE_RUNTIME_PASS
